title: Zoom - Zoom Conference Room Connector DNS Changes in Saudi Arabia Region: November 13, 2026 (No Operational Impact)
text:
Service: Zoom
Maintenance: Zoom Conference Room Connector DNS Changes in Saudi Arabia Region: November 13, 2026 (No Operational Impact)
Status: scheduled
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2026-11-13T19:30:00.000-08:00
Scheduled until: 2026-11-14T11:30:00.000-08:00
Updates:
- 2026-10-16T11:15:46.477-07:00: scheduled - As part of ongoing service enhancements for the Cloud Room Connector (CRC) service, Zoom will be updating DNS records for SIP/H.323 and IP endpoints in Saudi Arabia region .

Effective Date: November 14, 2026

Action Required

To avoid service disruption, we recommend reviewing your CRC endpoint configurations as soon as possible, updating your DNS records and Destination ip with the new entries, and removing the older legacy records before November 14, 2026. 

If you have any questions or issues, please contact Zoom Support.

DNS Record Updates

Saudi Arabia Region

We will update the data-center (DC) domains , along with their respective SRV-Records. An example of the change is as follows:

jed.zmvc.us >> sau.zoomcrc.com

Records to be replaced (A-Record and SRV-Record):

jed.zmvc.us:

_h323cs._tcp.jed.zmvc.us

_sip._tcp.jed.zmvc.us

_sips._tcp.jed.zmvc.us

_sip._udp.jed.zmvc.us

New records (A-Record and SRV-Record):

sau.zoomcrc.com:

_h323cs._tcp.sau.zoomcrc.com

_sip._tcp.sau.zoomcrc.com

_sips._tcp.sau.zoomcrc.com

_sip._udp.sau.zoomcrc.com

 

 

IP address to be updated Saudi Arabia Region

We will update the cloud room connector IP address for Jeddah .

170.114.55.1 >> 159.124.226.235
